post.description: Roll the period's usage ledger into one statement across the whole fleet.

Razorpay webhook — authenticated by HMAC signature, not by an API key.

The raw body is verified before anything is parsed or applied, so a forged event never moves
money. Returns 200 with ``handled`` so Razorpay does not retry a correctly-received event.

schema.title: Response Razorpay Webhook V1 Webhooks Razorpay Post

get.description: Durable metering-stream health: log head, event count, consumer offset, and lag.

post.description:
Replay the tenant's usage stream through the idempotent pipeline.

Safe to run any time: already-rated events are no-ops, so a healthy stream yields zero new
ledger entries and zero balance change (``exactly_once=True``); a captured-but-unrated gap is
repaired exactly once. This is both the exactly-once proof and the recovery tool.

get.description: Fair-scheduler capacity and this tenant's running/waiting share (fairness + backpressure).
